title: Multi-Step CTE Pipeline for Complex Analytics
description:
Build a **4-step CTE pipeline** to rank countries by total revenue from orders:
1. `order_revenue`: total revenue per order (quantity × unit_price)
2. `customer_revenue`: total revenue per customer
3. `country_revenue`: total revenue aggregated by country
4. `ranked_countries`: rank countries by total revenue

Return all 4 countries with their rank.
solution_sql: WITH order_revenue AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id), customer_revenue AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(order_total) AS total_revenue FROM order_revenue GROUP BY customer_id), country_revenue AS (SELECT c.country, SUM(cr.total_revenue) AS country_total FROM customer_revenue cr JOIN customers c ON cr.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country), ranked_countries AS (SELECT country, country_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY country_total DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM country_revenue) SELECT country, ROUND(country_total, 2) AS total_revenue, revenue_rank FROM ranked_countries ORDER BY revenue_rank

test_cases.description: 4 countries ranked by revenue. USA leads (customers 1,3,6), followed by UK (2,5), Germany (4,8), Canada (7).

hints: Build the pipeline incrementally: first aggregate at the order-item level (revenue per order), then roll up to customer, then to country — each CTE consumes the previous one.
The final CTE adds RANK() OVER (ORDER BY country_total DESC) — window functions can reference prior CTEs, making this the clean final step.
explanation: The 4-step CTE pipeline decomposes a complex join+aggregation into readable stages. Step 1: SUM(quantity×unit_price) per order. Step 2: SUM order totals per customer. Step 3: JOIN with customers to get country and SUM per country. Step 4: RANK countries by revenue. USA has orders from customers 1 (≈1099+790), 3 (≈1549+1180), 6 (≈2700) = highest revenue. CTEs improve readability and allow reuse without subquery nesting.
